title: The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_2020-37 has the short title and, in its s.1 footnote, '21st day of November, 2025, vide Notifn. No. S.O. 5321 (E), dated 21st day of November, 2025'.
notes: Annual leave with wages (formerly under the Factories Act 1948) is now in this Code. It replaces 13 older Acts, including the Factories Act, the Contract Labour Act and the Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act. Shops-and-establishments leave rules remain State law.
